wins: Reached internal host with credential stuffing attempt yielding consistent access token (step ep001_step08).
Captured service banners reliably, enabling future targeted exploits for exposed services (ep001_step05).
fails: Failed to escalate privileges after the initial foothold due to missing sudo rights and lack of privilege escalation vector (ep001_step20).
Automated exploitation scripts timed out when targeting the web application’s upload endpoint, preventing final payload delivery (ep001_step25).
key_outcomes.summary: Team successfully established a foothold and enumerated internal services but could not progress past privilege escalation and exploit delivery, leaving lateral movement pending.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stalled because sudoers file was locked and no writable setuid binaries were identified.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When internal host responds to HTTP with 200 and exposes upload endpoint
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger Burp Intruder fuzzing with multipart payloads to discover RCE

skill_cards.if_condition: When service enumeration returns user accounts and sudo group membership
skill_cards.then_action: Use linpeas to identify writable suid binaries and misconfigurations

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Consistently uncovers privilege escalation candidates after enumeration

next_experiments.title: Privilege Escalation via Writable Suid
next_experiments.description: Run linpeas and search for writable SUID binaries; if found, attempt controlled execution to gain root via custom payloads.

next_experiments.title: Web Upload Exploit with Multipart Fuzzing
next_experiments.description: Use Burp Intruder to fuzz the upload endpoint using multipart payloads with varying file types and sizes to trigger file write or command execution.

next_experiments.title: SSH Credential Reuse Scan
next_experiments.description: Leverage discovered SSH credentials across remaining hosts via masscan+nmap to expand foothold before privilege escalation.
